svg.title: CodexHalo feature walkthrough
svg.desc: A high-resolution animated browser preview: open the quota capsule, explore 7-day, 30-day and yearly history, set a reset reminder to 30 minutes, inspect token prices, check the daily price catalog, and reveal the quota-colored screen-edge handle. All screenshots use synthetic data captured at double resolution; screen docking is simulated.
svg.text: Token pricing · USD per million tokens
